verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents REST endpoint pages such as POST /acp/v1/instructions with a sample mandate, a sandbox for sending test transactions, code snippets, and a TAP reference implementation repo. None of it shows an interactive API reference or explorer where examples can be run in place. Static endpoint docs, a separate sandbox sign-up and a sample-code repo are adjacent developer resources, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
